Once again, it is not possible to discuss all such challenges in a short reflection, but a few are worth discussing. A first major real-world political-normative challenge comes from the current resurgence of great power conflict, as seen in the Russian invasion of Ukraine in early 2022 and the growing strategic rivalry between China and the US and its allies in the Asia-Pacific region. A powerful narrative among ir scholars, diplomats, politicians and media commentators is that the primary lesson of the Russian invasion is that international anarchy still exists, no state is safe from predation, and a strong military or military alliance is the best guarantee of international security. Large sections of the public, as well as most students of ir, would likely agree with this assessment.
